title: What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn? One Reverse Process in Three Coordinates
abstract: arXiv:2607.05381v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: What does a discrete diffusion model actually learn? The literature trains denoisers, bridge plug-ins, and concrete scores, each deriving its own ELBO objective under different conventions. This fragmentation makes the object being learned unclear and ELBO values difficult to interpret and compare. All three methods learn the same object in different coordinates: the exact time-reversal of the noising process. We first prove the Oracle Distance identity: for any noising process, the negative ELBO is not just a bound on the likelihood; it equals the data entropy plus the path KL divergence from the reversed noising process to the learned one. Next, for token-factorizing noise, we show that denoiser, bridge plug-in, and concrete score are three coordinates of this reverse process, derive exact conversions between them, and identify the probability distribution learned by each. translated_title: 离散扩散模型学到了什么？三种坐标系下的同一个逆向过程
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型究竟学到了什么？现有文献分别训练去噪器、桥接插件和具体分数，每种方法都在不同的约定下推导出自己的 ELBO 目标。这种碎片化使得所学习的对象不清晰，ELBO 数值也难以解释和比较。本文指出，这三种方法在不同的坐标系中学习的是同一个对象：加噪过程的精确时间反演。我们首先证明了 Oracle Distance 恒等式：对于任意加噪过程，负 ELBO 不仅仅是似然的一个界；它等于数据熵加上从反向加噪过程到所学过程的路径 KL 散度。接下来，针对令牌因子化的噪声，我们证明去噪器、桥接插件和具体分数是该逆向过程的三种坐标，推导出它们之间的精确转换关系，并确定了每种方法所学习的概率分布。特别是，与其标准解释相反……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明离散扩散模型中的去噪器、桥接插件和具体分数三种方法学习的其实是同一对象——加噪过程的精确时间反演，只是处于三种不同坐标系，并给出 Oracle Distance 恒等式（负 ELBO 等于数据熵加路径 KL 散度）及三种坐标间的精确转换。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that denoisers, bridge plug-ins, and concrete scores in discrete diffusion models all learn the same object—the exact time-reversal of the noising process—merely expressed in three different coordinates, establishing the Oracle Distance identity (negative ELBO equals data entropy plus path KL divergence) and exact conversions between the three coordinate systems.
